sn41.9:1.1: tena kho pana samayena acelo kassapo macchikasaṇḍaṃ anuppatto hoti cittassa gahapatino purāṇagihisahāyo.
sn41.9:1.2: assosi kho citto gahapati acelo kira kassapo macchikasaṇḍaṃ anuppatto amhākaṃ purāṇagihisahāyoti.
sn41.9:1.3: atha kho citto gahapati yena acelo kassapo tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā acelena kassapena saddhiṃ sammodi
sn41.9:1.4: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho citto gahapati acelaṃ kassapaṃ etadavoca
sn41.9:1.6: tiṃsamattāni kho me gahapati vassāni pabbajitassāti.
sn41.9:1.7: imehi pana te bhante tiṃsamattehi vassehi atthi koci uttarimanussadhammo alamariyañāṇadassanaviseso adhigato phāsuvihāroti.
sn41.9:1.8: imehi kho me gahapati tiṃsamattehi vassehi natthi koci uttarimanussadhammo alamariyañāṇadassanaviseso adhigato phāsuvihāro aññatra naggeyyā ca muṇḍeyyā ca vāḷanippotanāya cāti.
sn41.9:1.9: evaṃ vutte citto gahapati acelaṃ kassapaṃ etadavoca
sn41.9:1.10: acchariyaṃ vata bho abbhutaṃ vata bho
sn41.9:1.11: dhammassa svākkhātatā yatra hi nāma tiṃsamattehi vassehi na koci uttarimanussadhammo alamariyañāṇadassanaviseso adhigato bhavissati phāsuvihāro aññatra naggeyyā ca muṇḍeyyā ca vāḷanippotanāya cāti.
sn41.9:2.2: mayhampi kho pana bhante tiṃsamattāni vassāni upāsakattaṃ upagatassāti.
sn41.9:2.3: imehi pana te gahapati tiṃsamattehi vassehi atthi koci uttarimanussadhammo alamariyañāṇadassanaviseso adhigato phāsuvihāroti.
sn41.9:2.5: ahaṃ hi bhante yāvadeva ākaṅkhāmi vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmi.
sn41.9:2.6: ahaṃ hi bhante yāvadeva ākaṅkhāmi vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā dutiyajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmi.
sn41.9:2.7: ahaṃ hi bhante yāvadeva ākaṅkhāmi pītiyā ca virāgā …pe… tatiyajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmi.
sn41.9:2.8: ahañhi bhante yāvadeva ākaṅkhāmi sukhassa ca pahānā …pe… catutthajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmi.
sn41.9:2.9: sace kho panāhaṃ bhante bhagavatā paṭhamataraṃ byākareyyaṃ. anacchariyaṃ kho panetaṃ yaṃ maṃ bhagavā evaṃ byākareyya
sn41.9:2.10: natthi taṃ saññojanaṃ yena saññojanena saṃyutto citto gahapati puna imaṃ lokaṃ āgaccheyyāti.
sn41.9:2.11: evaṃ vutte acelo kassapo cittaṃ gahapatiṃ etadavoca
sn41.9:2.12: acchariyaṃ vata bho abbhutaṃ vata bho
sn41.9:2.13: dhammassa svākkhātatā yatra hi nāma gihī odātavasano evarūpaṃ uttarimanussadhammaṃ alamariyañāṇadassanavisesaṃ adhigamissati phāsuvihāraṃ
sn41.9:2.14: labheyyāhaṃ gahapati imasmiṃ dhammavinaye pabbajjaṃ labheyyaṃ upasampadanti.
sn41.9:3.1: atha kho citto gahapati acelaṃ kassapaṃ ādāya yena therā bhikkhū tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā there bhikkhū etadavoca
sn41.9:3.2: ayaṃ bhante acelo kassapo amhākaṃ purāṇagihisahāyo
sn41.9:3.5: alattha acelo kassapo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye pabbajjaṃ alattha upasampadaṃ.
sn41.9:3.6: acirūpasampanno ca panāyasmā kassapo eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto nacirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭhe va dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi
sn41.9:3.7: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti abbhaññāsi.
sn41.9:3.8: aññataro ca panāyasmā kassapo arahataṃ ahosīti.
